Trokhymbrid Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Volyn Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is the older of Trokhymbrid's two Jewish cemeteries, established after 1835, when Trokhymbrid was founded as a Jewish agricultural colony that Jews settled to gain exemption from military conscription; it served the communities of both Trokhymbrid and Hnativka, documented elsewhere in this collection, until its closure in the early 20th century. By 1897 the almost entirely Jewish village had reached 1,580 people. In early July 1941, local antisemites organized a pogrom, and the community was exterminated across two Aktions in late August and early September 1942, in which around 3,000 Jews were shot; a few dozen escaped to form a partisan detachment led by H. Rosenblat. Trokhymbrid is known today through its fictional portrayal in Jonathan Safran Foer's 2002 novel 'Everything Is Illuminated' and the film of the same name, directed by Liev Schreiber.
